name: The Peninsula Beijing
insider_take: The Peninsula Beijing isn't just luxury—it's a masterclass in timeless elegance where East meets West in perfect harmony.
whats_special: This iconic hotel sits in the heart of Beijing's shopping district, just steps from the Forbidden City. The Peninsula's legendary Rolls-Royce fleet (the largest hotel fleet in the world) provides arrivals that feel like red-carpet moments. The rooftop helipad offers exclusive helicopter tours over the Great Wall, while the award-winning spa features traditional Chinese medicine treatments in jade-adorned treatment rooms.
pro_tip: Book the Peninsula Suite for exclusive access to the helipad and complimentary airport transfers in the Rolls-Royce—plus, the suite's telescope offers stunning views of the Forbidden City's golden rooftops at sunset.
dont_miss: The hotel's legendary afternoon tea service featuring over 60 varieties of tea, and Huang Ting restaurant's Peking duck carved tableside by master chefs. Take advantage of the concierge's insider access to private sections of the Great Wall, available exclusively to Peninsula guests.
pros: Prime location in Beijing's prestigious Wangfujing district
Legendary Peninsula service with white-gloved attention to detail
Iconic fleet of Rolls-Royce vehicles for airport transfers
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Formal atmosphere may feel reserved for some guests
